levels.label: Explicit registry
levels.status_display: Two repositories are named with explicit paths
levels.allowed_claim: Fleet Radar reads an explicit local registry and preserves repository identity.
levels.forbidden_inference: Every repository in an organization is represented by this registry.

levels.label: Per-repository freshness
levels.status_display: Fresh ready and stale failed states remain visible
levels.allowed_claim: The snapshot keeps native receipt state and target freshness separate per repository.
levels.forbidden_inference: A stale receipt is current or a clean checkout proves readiness.

levels.label: Read-only refresh
levels.status_display: Repeated refresh leaves repository refs unchanged
levels.allowed_claim: Fleet Radar writes a bounded snapshot without mutating observed repository refs.
levels.forbidden_inference: Every provider or external destination is immutable under refresh.

levels.label: Receipt contract classification
levels.status_display: Shared envelope and supported producer receipts classify into explicit contract states
levels.allowed_claim: Fleet Radar recognizes the shared evidence envelope and supported producer receipt schemas while preserving malformed, mixed, mismatched, and unsupported states.
levels.forbidden_inference: Every upstream producer has already emitted a live receipt through the configured fleet registry.

levels.label: Native blocker follow-up
levels.status_display: Unresolved checks carry source-location or local-receipt link metadata
levels.allowed_claim: A Fleet Radar blocker points back to its owning source location or receipt path and includes a next action.
levels.forbidden_inference: The owning IDE or native tool was launched successfully from the link.

levels.label: Registry failure coverage
levels.status_display: Missing, unreadable, unavailable, duplicate, mixed, dirty, and race cases remain explicit
levels.allowed_claim: Fleet Radar preserves broad local registry and evidence failure states instead of collapsing them into a red or green score.
levels.forbidden_inference: A live concurrent filesystem race or every provider-specific failure mode has been exhaustively proven.

levels.label: Upstream receipt contract
levels.status_display: Real producer parity and direct native navigation remain open
levels.allowed_claim: The local contract and native-link model are ready for two real producer readbacks and direct navigation proof.
levels.forbidden_inference: Fleet Radar already has complete producer parity or live deep links.

levels.label: Binary preview
levels.status_display: Visually inspected 1600×900 PNG rendered from the candidate preview HTML
levels.allowed_claim: The Fleet Radar candidate has a crop-safe 16:9 PNG preview tied to the current preview HTML.
levels.forbidden_inference: The image is an externally hosted or destination-verified social card.

levels.label: Hosted case page
levels.status_display: Validated Sites version saved owner-only; public access and no-auth readback are pending explicit confirmation
levels.allowed_claim: A validated owner-only Sites version exists for the Fleet Radar case page.
levels.forbidden_inference: The case page is publicly reachable or can be opened without signing in.

levels.label: External release
levels.status_display: Public access confirmation is pending before deployment and no-auth readback
levels.allowed_claim: Public deployment and external publication remain blocked pending access confirmation.
levels.forbidden_inference: The fleet case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
